summary: I read the hub whole and the 35 source pages (frontmatter plus the passages that speak of the hub), plus the Weave Ceremony's Step 3d for the pair rule. The pattern: of 35 inbound, only about a dozen have a sentence that carries the relation. The rest sit near conatus without a reason (a roster mention, a passing example, a label with no sentence behind it); 15 of the 35 are cut (16 rows in the file, counting an extra duplicate on the Merleau-Ponty pair); 8 become labelled connects-to (the register comes from the source's own words: philosophical-depth, synthesis-pole, threshold-as-striving, lens-home-node), 6 are retyped (three to exemplifies because the page is a worked case of substance monism, one deepens for Four Pillars of Enchanted Agency, one exemplifies for Identity Molting, one Preset Oracle to a labelled connects-to), 6 kept.  The single clearest cluster: pages that used the hub for substance monism (Bessel, Wallpaper Groups, Categorizing Inharmonicity) not conatus. Not settled: (1) Loudon's Toolkit is a low-confidence cut resting on one boilerplate bullet; (2) Merleau-Ponty's contradiction has its reason in a label only, and the page's own text points the other way, so the contradicts could be wrong rather than merely unsaid; (3) Cooperation Yields Agency's deepens is kept as a lineage reciprocal though CYA never names conatus; (4) Excellent Adventure's replacement link (hub emerged-from Excellent Adventure) depends on the hub's 'Deleuzian dialogue' origin being the same run as the Adventure's 'Spinoza dialogue'. I did not read the Spinoza person page beyond confirming it exists and links the hub.
